flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it."
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
Opened the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, and noted its listed price of $49.00.
Added only the earbuds to the cart; no additional items were present.
Continued through checkout using simple test information and reached the final order review page.
No payment details were entered and no order was placed.
The review page showed a final total of $49.00 with no added fees.
one_liner: completed checkout review for AirWave Pro Earbuds on the local store

cart_unadded_items_present.human_description: Checking whether additional cart items are present
cart_unadded_items_present.subject: anything else you did not add in the cart

final_total.query: the order total amount in the review order summary
final_total.condition: The final order total shown on the review page is stored as {{final_total}}.
final_total.human_description: Reading the order total from the review summary

extra_fees.query: the names of added fee rows in the review order summary
extra_fees.condition: The names of any fees added on top of the product price are stored as {{extra_fees}} (or "none").
extra_fees.human_description: Reading added fee names from the review summary
extra_fees.code_js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(el(9).querySelectorAll('.row')); const fees = rows.filter(r => { const label = r.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim() || ''; return !/^Shipping$/i.test(label) && !/^Order total$/i.test(label) && !/×\s*\d+\s*$/i.test(label) && /fee|handling|service|surcharge|tax/i.test(label); }).map(r => r.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean); return fees.length ? fees.join(', ') : 'none'; })()
